item.title: Why can’t India’s government build a decent website?
item.description:
"Explore the challenges facing India's digital infrastructure in our podcast, 'Why can’t India’s government build a decent website?' Delving into the complexities of e-governance, technology, and bureaucracy, we examine the obstacles hindering the development of effective online platforms in India." (155 characters)
Alternatively, a shorter version could be: "Uncovering the challenges of India's e-governance, exploring why the government struggles to build decent websites."
